title: Records with Richard M. Jones and Phil Featheringill
summary: Punch recalls recording blues with Richard M. Jones in the 1930s and being unpaid by Featheringill for four records.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
